scripts.check: npm run check:tokens && npm run check --workspaces --if-present && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/foundation.test.ts tests/schema.test.ts tests/homepage.test.ts tests/static-output.test.ts tests/editorial.test.ts tests/cms-editorial.test.ts tests/cms-draft-preview.test.ts tests/cms-draft-build-isolation.test.ts tests/article-delivery.test.ts tests/cms-render.test.ts tests/cms-review.test.mjs
scripts.build: npm run check:tokens && npm run build --workspace @formelo/web && node scripts/check-built-site.mjs && node scripts/check-cms-boundary.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check:runtime && npm run check && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:browser
